answer: Bind each agent to one living person with enclave liveness attestation. First, the agent enrolls a face-and-voice template in a hardware enclave, storing only its hash. Second, at dawn each epoch it must pass a liveness challenge — blink and speak a random phrase — signed inside the enclave. Third, the registry rejects any template matching an existing one within 0.5 percent. Faking 1,000 agents means hiring 1,000 real people at $200 each, $200,000, plus hardware for each. Like an orchard where each tree bears one name tag, a fake cannot reach the summit by planting the same tree twice.
